source: firmware/src/config.h and library headers, via scripts/export_buoy_config.py

settings.label: Transmits a day
settings.description: How many of the day's transmit slots send a packet (1–3). 1 uses the first slot, 2 the first and last, 3 all three.

settings.label: Transmit slots
settings.description: Each comes 10 min after a sensor reading. The slot phase moves every slot 0–7 h later (default 0 h).

settings.label: Sensor readings
settings.description: How often the buoy wakes to read its sensors: every 15, 30 or 60 min.

settings.label: Hydrophone recordings
settings.description: One clip before each slot, summarised into the next packet; normal power mode only. Clip length 0, 15, 30 or 60 s, where 0 turns recording off. The 22,050 Hz sample rate is fixed.

settings.label: Power-saving thresholds
settings.value: Conserve below 3.20 V · critical below 3.10 V
settings.description: Below conserve the buoy skips audio and sends in every 3rd used slot; below critical it only logs temperature. The defaults will be retuned for the final battery pack.

settings.label: Housing humidity alert
settings.description: Readings at or above it are flagged HUMIDITY_HIGH, the first sign of a leak. The default is a placeholder until the leak calibration.

settings.label: Radio
settings.value: 915 MHz · +11 dBm · BW 500 kHz · SF12 · CR 4/8
settings.description: Fixed by the RFM95's FCC grant; the shore station must match it exactly.

settings.label: Settings listen window
settings.description: How long the buoy listens for a settings command. Fixed, so a bad value can never cut a buoy off.

settings.label: Firmware
settings.description: The version in the repo. Each buoy reports its own in every packet.

remote.label: Transmits a day
remote.help: How many of the three daily slots send a packet.

remote.label: Slot phase
remote.help: Moves every transmit slot and recording this many hours later.

remote.label: Hydrophone clip
remote.help: Length of each recording; 0 turns recording off.

remote.label: Conserve below
remote.help: Below this battery voltage the buoy skips audio and sends less.

remote.label: Critical below
remote.help: Below this it only logs temperature. At least 50 mV under conserve.

remote.label: Conserve: send every
remote.help: In conserve, transmit in every Nth used slot.

remote.label: Housing humidity alert
remote.help: Rows at or above it carry HUMIDITY_HIGH.
